FIELDS.NAME: Stitch & Style Embroidery
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Stitch & Style Embroidery specializes in high-quality embroidery and custom apparel production. Our core operations include designing unique garment decorations, using state-of-the-art commercial-grade embroidery machines and printing equipment. We offer a wide range of customization services to various clientele, including local businesses, schools, and organizations. Our commitment to quality is supported by stringent quality control protocols and practices to ensure a safe working environment for our employees. We maintain a detailed inventory management system to efficiently handle seasonal demands and ensure timely order fulfillment. Our production facility adheres to all local zoning and regulations, with measures in place to protect our assets. Additionally, we source materials from reputable suppliers to guarantee top-notch product quality.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Custom Creations LLC - a small custom embroidery and sewing service specializing in personalized gifts and promotional items.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss occurred on 06/15/2021 due to a minor electrical malfunction in one of the embroidery machines, resulting in $1,500 in damages. The machine was promptly repaired, and no further incidents have been reported. Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Commercial-grade, UL-listed safe with a class B rating, compliant with local security standards; secured within a monitored area to prevent unauthorized access.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel on-site during operating hours to monitor premises and deter theft.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Stitch & Style Embroidery does not store, treat, discharge, apply, dispose of, or transport hazardous materials as part of its operations. Our activities are focused solely on embroidery and custom apparel production, which does not involve hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: Yes – Stitch & Style Embroidery sponsors local athletic teams by providing custom apparel and team uniforms, supporting community engagement and promoting our services.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are checked by our operations manager to ensure compliance with our insurance policies.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There have been no indictments or convictions of any degree related to fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime associated with this property or the applicant.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Stitch & Style Embroidery has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the past three years. All coverage has been maintained without any interruptions.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Stitch & Style Embroidery does not lease employees to or from other employers. All employees are directly hired and managed within the company.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Stitch & Style Embroidery carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure employee safety and compliance with statutory requirements. This coverage provides essential protections for our staff in the event of work-related injuries or illnesses.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Stitch & Style Embroidery owns and operates Custom Creations LLC, which specializes in personalized gifts and promotional items through custom embroidery and sewing services.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Stitch & Style Embroidery currently does not have any other insurance policies with this company. All insurance coverage is specifically related to our embroidery and custom apparel operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Stitch & Style Embroidery is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations are focused solely on embroidery and custom apparel production without any additional product processing activities.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Stitch & Style Embroidery does not rent or loan equipment to others. Our operations are focused solely on providing high-quality embroidery and custom apparel services.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Stitch & Style Embroidery has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien within the past five years, indicating a stable financial standing.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Stitch & Style Embroidery does not have exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our operations are solely focused on embroidery and custom apparel production without the use of hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Stitch & Style Embroidery does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations are focused solely on embroidery and custom apparel production, without any involvement in high-risk activities or locations.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – There have been no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring for Stitch & Style Embroidery.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Stitch & Style Embroidery does not have any uncorrected fire code violations, ensuring compliance with local safety regulations.
